answer: Cohort revenue ceiling: each identity's payout is capped at a fixed pool split evenly across all siblings sharing one funding origin, so the marginal clone earns zero. Each new clone also requires a fixed fee, stamped on ivory, that the attacker must pay regardless of whether it earns anything. As siblings multiply, per-clone revenue slides into a canyon below that fee, and at the cohort's revenue summit the next clone is strictly negative-EV.
